word-primary-school.def: a place where young children from about age six to eleven get their first lessons

word-high-school.def: a place where teenagers study before they go to college or start working

word-faculty.def: a main division of a university, such as law, medicine or engineering

word-pupil.def: a child who goes to a place of learning every day

word-classmate.def: a person who studies in the same group as you at school

word-principal.def: the person in charge of a school

word-professor.def: a teacher of the highest rank at a university

word-tutor.def: a person who teaches one learner or a small group privately

word-classroom.def: a room in a school where lessons are held

word-blackboard.def: a dark board that teachers write on with chalk

word-eraser.def: a small piece of rubber used to remove pencil marks

word-ruler.def: a flat strip used to measure length and draw straight lines

word-semester.def: one of the two main periods that divide an academic year

word-school-year.def: the period of months, usually from autumn to summer, when lessons take place

word-enrollment.def: the act of officially signing up to join a course or a school

word-tuition-fee.def: the money you pay for lessons at a school or university

word-scholarship.def: money given to a student to help pay for studies

word-bachelor-degree.def: the first qualification a university gives, usually after about four years

word-master-degree.def: a higher qualification earned after the first one, usually in one or two more years

word-doctorate.def: the highest university qualification, earned after several years of original research

word-diploma.def: a paper that shows you have finished a course of study

word-certificate.def: an official paper that proves a fact, such as a birth or a finished course

word-graduate.def: to finish a course of study and receive a degree or a diploma

word-thesis.def: a long paper written to earn a university qualification

word-essay.def: a short piece of writing on a particular topic, often written for school

word-geography.def: the study of the earth's surface, countries, climate and people

word-physics.def: the study of matter, energy, motion and forces

word-chemistry.def: the study of what substances are made of and how they change

word-biology.def: the study of plants, animals and other living things

word-literature.def: written works such as novels, poems and plays

word-physical-education.def: the school subject in which children play sports and exercise

word-computer-science.def: the study of how to program machines that process information

word-philosophy.def: the study of big questions about truth, knowledge, right and wrong, and life

word-student-dormitory.def: a large building where college students live in rooms, often shared

word-cheat-sheet.def: a small paper with notes that someone secretly uses during a test
